meta.source: Clinic: bacsigiadinhhanoi.vn. Nursing home: fdcmedical.vn. Extracted 2026-10-12; low-contrast site colors darkened to 4.5:1. Version 2 (2026-10-24): accessibility upgrade for older patients (18px body, 48px controls, Be Vietnam Pro body, sentence-case buttons, semantic aliases). Version 2.1 (2026-10-25): staff-tool states from the hoso app (status-info for pending work and status tags). Version 2.2 (2026-10-29): review by Astra. text-link moved to brand-700 (it failed 4.5:1 on surface-alt), success green darkened, status colors fixed across themes, role tokens for every component use, a density layer.

tokens.name: brand-50
tokens.usage: Lightest tint. Zebra rows in tables. Nursing home value derived from the orange scale.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Pale fill for quiet highlighted areas. Nursing home value derived from the orange scale.

tokens.name: brand-200
tokens.usage: Section background tint (Clinic: About and News blocks; Nursing home: Reasons, Testimonials, Contact). Ink on it: 8.4:1 and 9.7:1.

tokens.name: brand-300
tokens.usage: Bright band color (Clinic: table header; Nursing home: menu bar and avatar ring). Ink text only, never white.

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: Primary brand color for actions, links and accent headings. Clinic: FDC blue #1c75bc. Nursing home: orange darkened from the site's #ec6810 so white text passes at 4.7:1.

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for brand-600; Clinic footer background. Nursing home value is the site's dark brown-orange (6.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: brand-800
tokens.usage: Deepest brand shade; pressed state and text on brand-100. Nursing home value derived.

tokens.name: group-600
tokens.usage: FDC group blue, the logo color, identical in every theme. Use it where a unit ties itself back to the group: value-card titles and section subtitles on the nursing home site. 4.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: leaf-500
tokens.usage: Logo secondary color (Clinic leaf green, Nursing home sage). Decorative only, never text or thin icons.

tokens.name: leaf-700
tokens.usage: Status and success text in green. Darkened in 2.2 from #577f20 (4.4:1 on surface-alt) to 5.0:1 on surface-alt and every tint, 5.5:1 on white; white text on it 5.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-600
tokens.usage: Hotline accent: hotline numbers and icons, both themes. Darkened from the site #df3386 to 4.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent-cta
tokens.usage: Floating hotline call button background. Darkened from the site #e23287 so white text passes at 4.7:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface (12.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Legacy secondary grey from the site (5.7:1 on white, but 3.8:1 on brand-200). New work uses text-muted, which points to ink-soft.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text that must stay readable on tinted sections: 4.7:1 on clinic brand-200, 5.4:1 on nursing-home brand-200, 7.0:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled text only (exempt from contrast rules). 4.5:1 on white but 4.2:1 on surface-alt, so never placeholders or hints: those use text-placeholder.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and card background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section background and input wells.

tokens.name: surface-button
tokens.usage: Legacy grey fill from the site. No longer used by components (the secondary button is white with a brand edge since 2.1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Decorative input well outline only. Too light for a control boundary (1.4:1); controls use border-control.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and invalid field borders. Darkened from the site's #dc3545 (4.5:1, failed on surface-alt) to 6.6:1 on white and 6.0:1 on surface-alt.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Boundary of text fields, checkboxes, radios and slot tiles at rest: 4.5:1 on surface, 4.2:1 on surface-alt (WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1).

tokens.name: info-50
tokens.usage: Fixed status blue, lightest: the pending/info background in every theme.

tokens.name: info-600
tokens.usage: Fixed status blue: pending/info edges and icons in every theme (4.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: info-800
tokens.usage: Fixed status blue, darkest: pending/info text (6.9:1 on info-50).

tokens.name: warning-50
tokens.usage: Fixed amber, lightest: warning background in every theme.

tokens.name: warning-600
tokens.usage: Fixed amber: warning edges and bars (4.2:1 on warning-50, 4.9:1 on white). Yellow-leaning so it never reads as the nursing-home orange.

tokens.name: warning-800
tokens.usage: Fixed amber, darkest: warning text (7.8:1 on warning-50).

tokens.name: action-primary-bg
tokens.usage: Semantic. Primary button and selected-slot fill; follows the theme.

tokens.name: action-primary-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Semantic. Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: text-on-action
tokens.usage: Semantic. Text and icons on action-primary-bg and accent-cta.

tokens.name: text-default
tokens.usage: Semantic. Body text and headings on surface, surface-alt and brand-200.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Semantic. Hints, captions, metadata. Never the only place important information appears.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Semantic. Links and text actions. brand-700 since 2.2: 5.8:1 on surface-alt and 6.3:1 on white in both themes (brand-600 failed on surface-alt: 4.498:1 clinic, 4.33:1 nursing home).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Semantic. 3px focus outline (focus-ring-width) with 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: status-success-text
tokens.usage: Semantic. Success and 'open now' text. Pair with an icon or words, never color alone.

tokens.name: status-error-text
tokens.usage: Semantic. Error messages and the error summary. Always with the word 'Lỗi' for screen readers.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Semantic. Pending work ("Chờ gửi · còn 27 giây") and info tags. Fixed blue in every theme since 2.2: a status color must mean the same thing in every app (orange reads as a warning).

tokens.name: status-info-border
tokens.usage: Semantic. Edge of pending panels and info notices: 4.5:1 on status-info-bg.

tokens.name: status-info-text
tokens.usage: Semantic. Text on status-info-bg: 6.9:1.

tokens.name: text-link-hover
tokens.usage: Semantic. Link hover and pressed.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Semantic. Brand-colored large headings (20px bold and up) and icons only: 3:1 is enough there; never body text.

tokens.name: text-brand-strong
tokens.usage: Semantic. Brand-colored text at any size (names, initials, text on tints): 7:1 and up.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Semantic. Placeholders and empty-field hints ("Chưa điền · ví dụ 78"): 6.5:1 on surface-alt. Never ink-subtle.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Semantic. Text of disabled controls only (exempt from contrast rules).

tokens.name: text-on-footer-muted
tokens.usage: Semantic. Secondary text on surface-footer (tagline, legal lines).

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Semantic. Selected tile, hovered option, the current row.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Semantic. Quiet brand-tinted fills: avatar circle, image placeholder.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Semantic. Solid brand fills that are not actions (specialty icon square, strong tag, current step); text on it is text-on-action.

tokens.name: surface-footer
tokens.usage: Semantic. Footer background.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Semantic. Dark fills: emergency band, dialog backdrop (at 70%).

tokens.name: border-brand
tokens.usage: Semantic. Brand-colored edges and dividers (hotline card, value card, footer divider).

tokens.name: decor-ring
tokens.usage: Semantic. Decorative avatar ring; never a boundary that must be seen.

tokens.name: action-primary-bg-active
tokens.usage: Semantic. Primary button while pressed.

tokens.name: action-secondary-fg
tokens.usage: Semantic. Secondary (white) button text.

tokens.name: action-secondary-edge
tokens.usage: Semantic. Secondary button inner edge (2px).

tokens.name: hotline-bg
tokens.usage: Semantic. Hotline call button fill; text-on-action on it.

tokens.name: group-accent
tokens.usage: Semantic. FDC group blue where a unit points back to the group, and the non-urgent CareCard band; the same blue in every theme.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Semantic. Warning panels and tags; fixed amber in every theme.

tokens.name: status-warning-border
tokens.usage: Semantic. Warning edges and FormNotice bars.

tokens.name: status-warning-text
tokens.usage: Semantic. Warning text.

tokens.name: hotline
tokens.usage: Semantic. Hotline numbers and their icons only; never errors, never decoration.

families.heading: Montserrat, "Be Vietnam Pro", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
families.body: "Be Vietnam Pro", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
families.sans: "Be Vietnam Pro", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.sample: Chăm sóc sức khỏe gia đình

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Block titles; the question on a booking step (26px).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Phòng khám mở cửa từ thứ Hai đến Chủ nhật.
styles.usage: Default text on patient and family screens (18px). Older readers need this size; do not go smaller on public pages.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Đặt lịch trước để được phục vụ nhanh hơn.
styles.usage: Staff tools and dense lists (16px). The smallest size for any sentence a patient must read.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels and field-level text (16px, medium).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata and footnotes only (14px). Never the only carrier of important information.

styles.name: label-button
styles.usage: Button labels (18px semibold), sentence case. Uppercase was dropped: it is slower to read and crowds Vietnamese tone marks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Tight padding inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Grid gutter (half) and container side padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-50
tokens.usage: Large section bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Default for buttons, inputs and cards; the site's dominant radius.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Image tiles and larger panels.

tokens.name: radius-leaf
tokens.usage: Nursing home signature 'leaf' corner: applied to the top-left and bottom-right corners only (border-radius: radius-leaf 0) on images and accordion headers, in the nursing-home theme only.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Rounded promo blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill tags and rounded call-to-action chips.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars and circular icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards and dropdowns.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Small floating controls.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width on desktop.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and single-line inputs (48px). Raised from the site's 40px for older hands.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target anywhere (44px), including icon buttons and links in lists.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus-ring outline.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus-ring outline.

tokens.name: border-width-strong
tokens.usage: Invalid-field borders: thicker than the 1px rest border so errors show without relying on color.

tokens.name: border-width-heavy
tokens.usage: Error summary frame and forced-colors selection.

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: Avatar ring on testimonials (brand-300).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text (about 70 characters at 18px).

tokens.name: font-size-body
tokens.usage: Running text and control labels (18px). The compact density (data-density="compact", staff tools) lowers it to 1rem.
